diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VIN, datasheet reading says UPDI
diffs.evidence: The Adafruit EAGLE board file for product 5740 numbers header JP1 pads 1-6 as VCC(VIN), GND, SCL, SDA, INT, UPDI, so the model's pin order is right and the second reading listed the same six pads in reverse (right-to-left) order; the file shows '<signal name="VCC"> <contactref element="CONN3" pad="2"/> <contactref element="CONN4" pad="2"/> <contactref element="C2" pad="1"/> <contactref element="X2" pad="4"/> <contactref element="R3" pad="2"/> <contactref element="C3" pad="1"/> <contactref element="C4" pad="1"/> <contactref element="JP1" pad="1"/>'.

diffs.diff: chip ID register 0x1: part 134, datasheet reading 135
diffs.evidence: The Adafruit guide says the board carries 'the ATtiny816 running the seesaw firmware' and Adafruit_seesaw.h defines '#define SEESAW_HW_ID_CODE_TINY816 0x86' (=134), while 0x87 (135) is the ATtiny817 code, so HW_ID 134 is right.
